name: X-ray repair cross complementing 6

function.text: XRCC6 encodes DNA repair protein Ku70. Annotated molecular activities include transcription cis-regulatory region binding and 5'-deoxyribose-5-phosphate lyase activity. It participates in telomere maintenance and negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription.
